name: io.github.agentdata-api/mcp-server
description: Crypto market data for AI agents via x402. 16 tools: prices, funding, DeFi yields, arbitrage, TA.

environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key (0x-prefixed) for auto-paying requests with USDC on Base Mainnet. If not set, the server returns 402 payment info and the client handles payment manually.
environmentVariables.name: AGENTDATA_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the AgentData API base URL (default: https://agentdata-api.com)
environmentVariables.name: AGENTDATA_BASE_URL
